products.name: Toolbox
products.distribution: GitHub Releases, NSIS per-user installer, portable EXE
products.notes: No account, no cloud, no telemetry. Unsigned installers trigger SmartScreen.

products.name: Bartender Aid
products.distribution: Google Play and App Store (planned), Render backend
products.notes: API has three endpoints, no OpenAPI, no auth, wildcard CORS.

mapping.5: 85-100 on the 48-check framework, agent-ready, formal schema and complete docs
mapping.4: 70-84, agent-ready with one or two caveats
mapping.3: 50-69, needs work, API exists but incomplete or paid-gated
mapping.2: 30-49, not ready, no public API or only brittle browser automation
mapping.1: 0-29, manual only, no practical automation path

scoring.note: Readiness measures agent/API operability, not product quality. A manual directory can score 2 and still be worth submitting.

vendors.name: GitHub Pages
vendors.api: Git push or GitHub Actions; REST Pages API
vendors.freeTier: Free for public repositories on GitHub Free
vendors.limits: 1 GB site; 100 GB/month bandwidth soft limit; 10 builds/hour soft limit; HTTPS custom domains
vendors.lockIn: Low; static files stay in the repository
vendors.gdpr: GitHub/Microsoft DPA; access logs; static hosting only
vendors.reason: Repo-native, free, sufficient bandwidth, custom domain and HTTPS supported

vendors.name: Cloudflare Pages
vendors.api: REST API; Wrangler CLI; Git integration
vendors.limits: 500 builds/month; 20 concurrent builds; 20,000 files per deployment; unlimited bandwidth and requests; Workers static assets is the recommended path for new projects
vendors.lockIn: Low; static output and standard DNS
vendors.gdpr: Cloudflare DPA; EU options; free Web Analytics
vendors.reason: Good scale/edge option; more setup than GitHub Pages

vendors.name: Netlify
vendors.limits: 300 credits/month; bandwidth 20 credits/GB (about 15 GB if all credits go to bandwidth); builds consume credits; legacy 100 GB/300 min figures are not current
vendors.gdpr: Netlify DPA; US/EU options
vendors.reason: Excellent API and previews, but the credit model is less predictable

vendors.name: Vercel
vendors.limits: 100 GB fast data transfer; 10 GB fast origin transfer; 1M CDN requests; 4 CPU-hours; personal, non-commercial use only
vendors.lockIn: Medium to high if Next.js features are used
vendors.gdpr: Vercel DPA; US/EU regions
vendors.reason: Hobby is non-commercial and the project does not need a Next.js runtime

vendors.name: GoatCounter
vendors.freeTier: Hosted free for reasonable public usage
vendors.limits: No published hard cap; about 100k pageviews/month is commonly cited but unverified; self-host unlimited
vendors.lockIn: Low; data export and self-host escape
vendors.gdpr: Cookie-free; no personal data; check hosted DPA
vendors.reason: Best zero-cost combination of API, UTM/referrer reporting, and cookie-free tracking

vendors.name: Umami Cloud
vendors.limits: 1 website; 100k events/month; API not included on Hobby; Pro $20/month includes API
vendors.lockIn: Low to medium; export and self-host escape
vendors.gdpr: Cookie-free; verify DPA and data region on the paid plan
vendors.reason: API is paid and the free tier is limited to one website

vendors.name: Umami self-host
vendors.api: REST API v2; API keys in v3.4+
vendors.limits: Unlimited events and websites; server and Postgres cost only
vendors.gdpr: Full control; you are the processor; EU hosting possible
vendors.reason: Best ownership option; requires server maintenance

vendors.name: Plausible
vendors.limits: Starter $9/month for 10k pageviews
vendors.gdpr: Cookie-free; EU-based; strong GDPR posture
vendors.reason: Best paid analytics, but not part of the zero-cost stack

vendors.name: Cloudflare Web Analytics
vendors.limits: No published pageview cap; limited event and UTM model
vendors.gdpr: Cookie-free; Cloudflare DPA; no cross-site tracking
vendors.reason: Free independent traffic check; not a full product analytics tool

vendors.name: Buttondown
vendors.limits: Free up to 100 subscribers; custom-domain sending included; pricing assumes at most one email/day to the full list; free-plan API access is not stated on the pricing page
vendors.gdpr: US processor; consent, double opt-in, and DPA required
vendors.reason: Best launch fit for a developer audience; verify free-plan API access

vendors.name: MailerLite
vendors.limits: 250 subscribers; 2,500 emails/month; 2 seats; paid plans from about $10/month
vendors.gdpr: EU-based (Lithuania); strong GDPR fit; DPA
vendors.reason: Best EU/GDPR option, but the free tier was reduced

vendors.name: Kit (ConvertKit)
vendors.limits: 10,000 subscribers; unlimited email sends; 1 user; no visual automations or sequences on Free; API available on Free
vendors.gdpr: US processor; DPA/SCCs; consent required
vendors.reason: Best free scale, but no automation on Free

vendors.name: Buffer
vendors.auth: Personal API key or OAuth app client
vendors.limits: 3 channels; 10 scheduled posts per channel at a time; 1 API key; 150 requests/15 min; 600/day; 1,000/channel up to 3,000/30 days
vendors.gdpr: US processor; DPA; social platform data
vendors.reason: API available on Free with published limits

vendors.name: Publer
vendors.limits: 3 social accounts; 10 scheduled posts/account; 25 drafts; API reportedly gated to Business (~$21/month)
vendors.gdpr: Check DPA and data region
vendors.reason: API paywall breaks the zero-cost constraint; verify plan gating

vendors.name: Postiz
vendors.limits: No channel limits when self-hosted; hosted from $29/month
vendors.gdpr: Full control; you are the processor
vendors.reason: Self-host option if server maintenance is acceptable

vendors.name: Later
vendors.limits: Free plan heavily capped (1 social set; roughly 5-12 posts/month depending on source)
vendors.gdpr: US processor; DPA; platform data
vendors.reason: No public API and a capped free plan

vendors.name: Product Hunt
vendors.api: GraphQL API; OAuth user flow, client-only token, PKCE, or developer token
vendors.limits: 6,250 complexity points/15 min; launch is manual; 12:01 AM PT; can schedule up to 1 month ahead; write access is partial and use-case gated
vendors.gdpr: US platform; public data; account DPA
vendors.reason: Best launch channel; API is read-mostly and does not replace the manual flow

vendors.name: AlternativeTo
vendors.limits: Moderation; requires app details and alternatives
vendors.gdpr: Public data
vendors.reason: Free long-tail discovery; manual only

vendors.name: Softpedia
vendors.limits: Review typically about 14 days (third-party estimate)
vendors.gdpr: Public data
vendors.reason: Free listing and backlink; submit early

vendors.name: FossHub
vendors.limits: Curated; acceptance not guaranteed; may host binaries
vendors.gdpr: Public data; US-hosted
vendors.reason: Good FOSS credibility, but selective and manual

vendors.name: winget-pkgs
vendors.limits: Manifest with installer URL and SHA256; automated validation; unsigned installers accepted but SmartScreen remains
vendors.gdpr: No user data
vendors.reason: Schema-driven and automatable; highest-leverage Windows channel

vendors.name: Chocolatey Community Repository
vendors.limits: Human moderation plus virus scan; checksum required; silent install required; no listing fee
vendors.gdpr: No user data
vendors.reason: Free and trusted; moderation adds latency

vendors.name: Microsoft Store (MSIX)
vendors.api: Store submission API; Developer CLI; Partner Center
vendors.freeTier: Free individual and company registration in 2026
vendors.limits: MSIX packaging and certification required; Store-managed code signing at no cost
vendors.lockIn: Medium; Store policies, certification, package identity
vendors.gdpr: Microsoft DPA; Store privacy policy required
vendors.reason: Free Store signing is the cleanest SmartScreen fix; packaging effort is the cost

vendors.name: Google Play
vendors.limits: $25 one-time registration; internal testing up to 100 testers; new personal accounts need 12 testers for 14 continuous days of closed testing before production; developer verification
vendors.lockIn: Medium; Play policies, data safety form, review
vendors.gdpr: Google DPA; Data safety form; privacy policy
vendors.reason: Fastest mobile path; plan for the 14-day production gate

vendors.name: Apple App Store
vendors.limits: $99/year; TestFlight up to 10,000 external testers; App Review required
vendors.lockIn: Medium to high; App Review, privacy labels, platform fees
vendors.gdpr: Apple DPA; privacy nutrition labels; ATT if tracking
vendors.reason: Defer until Android retention proves the port is worth it

vendors.name: GitHub Issues
vendors.limits: 5,000 authenticated REST requests/hour; issue templates already in the repo
vendors.lockIn: Low to medium; data in GitHub
vendors.gdpr: GitHub DPA; public issue content
vendors.reason: Free, API-first, and already where the code lives

vendors.name: Sentry
vendors.api: DSN ingest; REST API for management
vendors.auth: DSN for events; API token for management
vendors.limits: 5,000 errors/month; 1 user; 50 replays; 5 GB logs
vendors.lockIn: Medium; self-host option and event export
vendors.gdpr: US processor; DPA; PII scrubbing; opt-in required
vendors.reason: Useful for Bartender Aid; default Sentry would break Toolbox's no-telemetry promise

vendors.name: Dub.co
vendors.freeTier: Free tier reported by third parties
vendors.limits: Reported 25 new links/month, 1,000 tracked events/month, 30-day retention; not visible on the current pricing page; Pro about $30/month; self-host AGPL-3.0
vendors.gdpr: US processor; click data; DPA; self-host for control
vendors.reason: Useful for social bios; verify the free tier before relying on it

vendors.name: Cloudflare Worker short links
vendors.limits: 100,000 requests/day; KV/D1 free quotas apply
vendors.lockIn: Low; you own the code and data
vendors.gdpr: Full control; you define retention
vendors.reason: Self-hosted redirects without a vendor

vendors.name: Direct UTM links
vendors.limits: No vendor limits
vendors.gdpr: No third-party click tracking
vendors.reason: Enough for launch and avoids another privacy surface

vendors.name: Resend
vendors.limits: 3,000 emails/month; 100/day; 3 domains; 30-day retention
vendors.lockIn: Low to medium; logs and domain setup are portable
vendors.gdpr: US processor; DPA; transactional data; SPF/DKIM required
vendors.reason: Best transactional API; not a newsletter platform

vendors.name: n8n self-host
vendors.freeTier: Free self-host under the Sustainable Use License
vendors.limits: Fair-code licence; server and maintenance cost only
vendors.gdpr: Full control; you are the processor
vendors.reason: Overkill while GitHub Actions covers scheduled work

vendors.name: Apify
vendors.freeTier: Free plan with $5 monthly usage credit
vendors.limits: $5/month usage; $0.20/compute unit; Starter $19/month
vendors.lockIn: Low to medium; run data export
vendors.gdpr: US processor; DPA; scraping compliance is the user's responsibility
vendors.reason: Useful for a bounded one-off scrape; not a launch dependency

vendors.name: UptimeRobot
vendors.limits: 50 monitors; 5-minute checks; 1 status page; API included
vendors.gdpr: US processor; minimal data; check commercial terms
vendors.reason: Good secondary monitor; slower checks than Better Stack

vendors.name: Better Stack
vendors.limits: 10 monitors; 10 heartbeats; 3-minute checks; status page; API included
vendors.lockIn: Low to medium; status page branding
vendors.gdpr: Verify DPA and data region; monitors hold minimal data
vendors.reason: Best free primary monitor with a status page and API

vendors.name: Uptime Kuma
vendors.api: Self-host; Socket.io and Prometheus metrics; limited REST
vendors.auth: Self-host auth; API keys for Prometheus
vendors.limits: You run the server; status page included; no full official REST API
vendors.gdpr: Full control; EU hosting possible
vendors.reason: Capable self-host option, but limited API and more maintenance

categories.name: Adjacent vendors already in the stack

vendors.name: Render
vendors.limits: Free web service sleeps after 15 minutes idle; Starter $7/month (0.5 CPU, 512 MB); health check path already configured
vendors.lockIn: Low to medium; standard Node app
vendors.gdpr: US/EU regions; DPA
vendors.reason: Cold starts hurt mobile UX; upgrade before public launch

vendors.name: Neon
vendors.limits: 100 projects; 1 GB storage/project; 100 CU-hours/month
vendors.gdpr: Region-selectable with EU options; DPA available
vendors.reason: Free tier is sufficient for early Bartender Aid usage

vendors.name: GitHub
vendors.limits: Actions free for standard runners on public repositories; Releases API stable
vendors.gdpr: GitHub DPA
vendors.reason: Source, releases, issues, and automation in one place

vendors.name: Cloudflare DNS and Registrar
vendors.limits: Domain about $10-15/year for .com (verify at checkout); Web Analytics free
vendors.gdpr: Cloudflare DPA; EU options
vendors.reason: Cheapest domain path and free DNS/analytics

oneTimeCosts: Google Play registration: $25 (only if shipping Android beyond local testing)
Apple Developer Program: $99/year (only if shipping iOS)

choices.crash: None in Toolbox; Sentry Free for Bartender Aid

optionalWithinCeiling: Cloudflare Workers Paid $5/month if free request limit is exceeded (total $30)
Do not add Sentry Team ($26), Buffer paid channels, or Dub Pro; they break the ceiling

firstIntegrations.name: Deploy landing page to GitHub Pages
firstIntegrations.acceptance: HTTPS site serves the landing page; HTTP redirects; download points to latest release; 360 px layout works

firstIntegrations.name: Add GoatCounter and UTM convention
firstIntegrations.auth: Per-site API token for reads; tracking script needs no auth
firstIntegrations.acceptance: Visits appear; UTM links attribute correctly; analytics sets no cookies

firstIntegrations.name: Wire newsletter form to Buttondown
firstIntegrations.acceptance: Test signup receives confirmation; subscriber shows source/consent; unsubscribe and export work

firstIntegrations.name: Automate winget manifest
firstIntegrations.acceptance: winget install works on a clean Windows VM; manifest PR passes validation; next release updates with one command

firstIntegrations.name: Create Better Stack monitors and status page
firstIntegrations.acceptance: Forced failure alerts within 5 minutes; status page shows site, release, and API health; Render stays warm

ownerDecisions.default: Buttondown Free; switch to Kit or MailerLite at 90 subscribers
No in-app telemetry in Toolbox; Sentry Free for Bartender Aid only
Evaluate Microsoft Store MSIX (free Store signing) before buying a certificate
Android internal testing now; iOS after 30-day retention
After site, download, and first-run are stable
Approve $0 now; pre-approve $25/month if growth justifies it
